text:
kaya: heads-up: deploybot started rolling `quant-kernel-6.1` to ap-south-1. Canary shows intermittent memory-pressure and a couple of kernel panics.

deploybot: ACTION: rollout initiated for bundle quant-kernel-6.1 in ap-south-1. Canary slice: 15 hosts. (status: 1749967890)

sre-bot: telemetry: 50th latency +8%, 95th +20%, error-rate 1.5%. Kernel panics on 2 hosts (see traces). Link: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/canary/1749967890

ops_liz: can we isolate panics to hardware revision or driver?

kaya: traces show GPU watchdog resets and `nvml: GPU hang detected` around the panic timestamps.

tony: that smells like a kernel change touching driver timeout behavior in qk6.1. If panics are reproducible, we should pause and pin to qk5.10.

priya: agree. propose: 1) set pin TTL 1h, 2) pause rollout in ap-south-1, 3) run nightly repro with stress config: seq_len=1024, batch=4.

ops_liz: preparing rollback play. Need confirmation within 5m.

kaya: confirmed. @deploybot reduce pin TTL to 1h and pause region. Also notify product.

deploybot: UPDATE: Pin TTL set to 1h by kaya. Rollout paused in ap-south-1.

sre-bot: ticket RED-3321 opened: "quant-kernel-6.1 ap-south-1 canary: GPU hangs and kernel panics". Attach traces.

tony: I'll reproduce on a staging node and check nv driver logs. If it's driver timeout, we might add a short watchdog tweak, but until then rollback to qk5.10.

priya: drafting brief release note: "HOLD: quant-kernel-6.1 paused in ap-south-1 due to GPU hangs on select hardware; investigating."

kaya: thanks. Will follow up with root cause and next steps. :thumbsup:
